description: Hide a getting-started card on Home: first_run (Your first post), link_page (Finish your page), niche (What is this account about?) or voice (Your agent can learn your voice). The first Hide lasts a week, then the card comes back once; hiding it again keeps it off for good. today_summary lists it in hidden_cards, on web and iPhone alike. The person hides cards in the app; call this only when they ask. first_run.next_step still leads to setup.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: home_hide
title: Hide a Home card
